title: CVX-4404 on enqueue even though the worker is running

posts.author: jenny_r
posts.body: `corvex enqueue ReindexAccount --arg id=90` returns `CVX-4404 job class not registered on any worker`. But `corvex status` shows 3 workers up. The handler file is `jobs/reindex_account.py` and the class is `ReindexAccount`. What am I missing?

posts.author: deploy_dana
posts.body: Workers only register handlers that are actually imported at startup. If your workers boot from an entrypoint that doesn't import `jobs/reindex_account.py` (e.g. you added it after the last deploy, or it's only imported lazily), the class never registers. Check the worker startup logs for a `registered N job classes` line and see if ReindexAccount is listed. Usually the fix is adding it to your jobs `__init__.py` / registry module and redeploying the workers.

posts.author: jenny_r
posts.body: Yep — it wasn't in `jobs/__init__.py`. Added it, redeployed workers, `registered 18 job classes` now includes it and enqueue works. Thanks.
